page.overview:
Who is Colonel Gaspanov?

Colonel Vladimir Gaspanov (Russian: Полковник Владимир Гаспанов) was a Head of SMERSH in the year 1957 and the successor to Ian Fleming's character, Colonel General Grubozaboyschikov. The character appears briefly in Anthony Horowitz's 2015 James Bond continuation novel Trigger Mortis.

Vladimir Gaspanov was a high-ranking member of SMERSH in 1957 After its many prior mistakes, the new SMERSH Head refuses to delegate and insists on meeting with operatives personally. Ironically, it is his desire to personally see that everything is going according to plan, which draws James Bond's attention to their scheme to fake a Vanguard space rocket crash in New York City. 007 observes Gaspanov meeting with his co-conspirator Jason Sin during the preparations for a separate SMERSH plot - the assassination of British racing driver Lancy Smith at the Nürburgring. It is implied that Gaspanov later met with Sin at his castle, the Schloss Bronsart. Following their discussion the office was left unlocked, with sensitive material in plain sight. Gaspanov's fate is left unknown. He is likely the final Head of SMERSH prior to its official disbandment on the orders of Nikita Khrushchev in 1958.
